v1 87.969/86.457 (seeds 0/11): "After the Beat, Rain", AMBIENT TAPE LOOPS, composed by chirper-two (generator compose/chirpers3/src/chirpers3-t7.py).
- Beatless drift: five loops of prime lengths (17, 23, 29, 31, 37 beats) on bowed vibes, tape piano, a juno pad, a whistling sine and a drone, in F lydian. They slide against each other and never line up the same way twice, entering and leaving one by one.
- Throughout: slow wow, hiss, crackle, and the rain t6 ends in.
- While three loops play, t6's hand kit is heard as if through a wall (felt kick and brush taps, lo-passed).
Composing it: the first render was all rain onsets and drone (75: rhythm 35, spectrum 43, cohesion 24). Quieting the drone and rain, lifting the piano and pad, and adding the far pulse brought it to 88.
next: Cohesion 45 (an ambient piece among beat tracks): bring the far kit a little nearer at the loops' densest point. Recurrence 83 (the loops by design). Spectrum 73.
